diagnosis: The CRDT awareness endpoint handles presence information (user IDs, email addresses, names, current active element, and cursor coordinates) for collaborative editing rooms. It authenticates the token but fails to verify that the user has access to room_id, leaking user identities, online status, and activity traces of other organizations.
